name: Tales Of Tanorio (Beta)
desc:
The early game story has been overhauled please keep an eye out for further updates in the upcoming weeks!

It's time to challenge everything you know! ✨
Tales Of Tanorio is a brand new Roblox MMO within the creature catching genre. 

Pick your Starter 🌱 🔥 💧
Embark on your Adventure! 🌎
Catch your own Tanorians! 🐾
Complete your Tanopedia! 📖
Battle the Stadium Stars! ⚔️
Increase your Tamer level! 📈

Tales Of Tanorio is in a early stage of development. You can currently take on 3 Stadiums. We want to bring you a truly amazing Roblox MMO experience, so stick along for the ride. Let's go!
